plugins.title: LOK Universe SDK
plugins.summary: Shared cards, rarity colours, wallet strip, supporter bar, playtime and achievements contracts. Vendored: change it in Lok-EcoSystsem/universe-sdk and run sync-sdk.sh.

plugins.title: LOK client
plugins.summary: Supabase-backed sign-in, saves, economy, LokDex, feedback and supporters for LOK apps.
plugins.cost: Uses the shared project; reads are cached feeds.

plugins.title: LokErrorReport
plugins.summary: Catches crashes, shows a themed pop-up with the exact code line in dev, stores reports on device and (on request) in LOK cloud, documents crashes in the repo and CI.
plugins.cost: Free; nothing is sent unless the player presses Send.

plugins.title: LOK Chat
plugins.summary: A game-agnostic conversation engine: follow-ups, topics that deepen with closeness, feelings, crew-to-crew scenes, group chat, moods and memory. Authored and deterministic; every feature has an on/off switch.

plugins.title: Run recap
plugins.summary: Renders run recaps and shareable poster cards.
plugins.cost: Rendering runs on demand (manual CI), never per commit.

plugins.title: Auto-translate
plugins.summary: Fills in the other language files from en.json after a push.

plugins.title: LOK Ecosystem tooling
plugins.summary: This catalog, the manifest checker (lok:check), the status report (lok:status) and the new-app starter kit (lok:new-app).

plugins.title: LokServer knowledge
plugins.summary: The shop host as a shared plugin: voice, topics and knowledge any app can mount.

plugins.title: World feed and postcards
plugins.summary: One cached daily payload and fixed-phrase postcards between players (no free text).
plugins.cost: Planned; one cached read for everyone.
